summary: Cleanup removed lifecycle state after SIGTERM delivery without confirming Chromium exit; fixed with pidfd signaling and bounded exit confirmation.
Background heartbeat persistence could race cleanup and reclaim a newly active browser; fixed with synchronous lease updates and reconnect refresh under lock.
PID validation and signaling used separate unstable PID operations; fixed by opening and signaling through a pidfd after exact process validation.
Standalone cleanup had no periodic invoker and therefore could not run without MCP; fixed with an enabled 30-minute systemd user timer.
Chromium rewrites root argv into one space-separated procfs field so production roots were undiscoverable; fixed with dual-form parsing and a regression test.
Predictable /tmp registry and lock opens followed symlinks and used permissive modes; fixed with no-follow owned regular-file checks, random atomic temp files, and mode 0600.
Corrupt registry reads and failed atomic writes silently became empty or successful state; fixed to fail closed and propagate errors.

DevTools listeners were attached to every page unconditionally; Playwright subscribes the Node driver on the first listener, so every request/console event was serialized to Python even when recording was off. Fixed: listeners attach on devtools on and detach on off (verified: no console/request subscriptions while off).

Secret redaction used a short allowlist, skipped values ≤12 chars, leaked an 8–12 char prefix, and never covered cookie values in get_storage or JSON/form fields in bodies. Fixed: substring name match, scheme+length only, cookie/body masking, explicit reveal=true opt-out.
inspect_element had no error handling: an invalid CSS selector or a destroyed execution context surfaced as a raw Playwright stack. Fixed: caught in the page JS and in the tool with a plain message.
get_source decoded base64 binary resources (images, fonts) as UTF-8 and printed up to 12K chars of replacement-character noise. Fixed: binary types/mimes return a one-line placeholder.
Computed-style filter dropped every 'none' value, hiding pointer-events:none — exactly the value a click-does-nothing debugger needs. Fixed with per-property default lists; found by a unit test.
forget_tab only dropped the page URL; buffered entries kept the dead id(page), which CPython reuses, so a later tab could inherit them. Fixed: entries purged on tab close.
set_device reloads the page but did not mark an action boundary or append the DevTools summary, so its traffic was attributed to the previous action. Fixed.
types/level/since filters were case-sensitive and a negative limit sliced from the wrong end; 'assert' console type was not treated as an error. Fixed: normalised, limit ≤0 means all, assert→error.

Storage dump evaluated the localStorage getter outside try, so opaque/sandboxed origins failed the whole evaluate (cookies lost too); Page.enable was left on in the persistent CDP session after get_source. Fixed: per-area guards, Page.disable in finally.
if __name__ == '__main__' sat mid-file before three test classes, so running the file directly skipped them. Moved to the end; drain helper made deterministic.
